End every sentence with the label of the chunk it comes from, written exactly as given, for example [boyd10k; Item 7; p. 37; c0412]. Where the rule above says NOT IN TEXT, reply exactly NOT IN CORPUS. When a chunk states what the company expects or plans, write that the document states it.
